options: The data show a clear trend.
The data shows a clear trend.
The data showing a clear trend.
The data is show a clear trend.
answers: The data show a clear trend.
questions.explanation: 在正式学术英语中，data通常被视为复数名词，谓语动词用复数形式show。
questions.evidence: His records showed that insurance premiums had actually fallen slightly

options: She is taller than her brother.
She is more taller than her brother.
She is more tall than her brother.
She is tallest than her brother.
answers: She is taller than her brother.
questions.explanation: tall的比较级是taller，不能加more，也不能双重比较。
questions.evidence: there were fewer luxury items and more everyday utensils

options: Each of the students has a book.
Each of the students have a book.
Each of the students having a book.
Each of the students are have a book.
answers: Each of the students has a book.
questions.explanation: each of后接复数名词，但谓语动词用单数has。
questions.evidence: each discipline has its own standards

options: This book is more interesting than that one.
This book is interestinger than that one.
This book is more interesting that one.
This book is most interesting than that one.
answers: This book is more interesting than that one.
questions.explanation: 多音节形容词interesting的比较级用more interesting，比较对象用than。

options: The number of students is increasing.
The number of students are increasing.
The number of students increasing.
The number of students be increasing.
answers: The number of students is increasing.
questions.explanation: the number of作主语时，谓语动词用单数is。

options: My sister is older than me.
My sister is elder than me.
My sister is more old than me.
My sister is oldest than me.
answers: My sister is older than me.
questions.explanation: old的比较级是older，elder通常只用于家人长幼，且不跟than。

options: Neither of the answers is correct.
Neither of the answers are correct.
Neither of the answers correct.
Neither of the answers be correct.
answers: Neither of the answers is correct.

This test is most easy than the last one.

title: The Evidence Integration Seminar · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
在英语写作中，主谓一致和比较级是常见的错误点。主谓一致指主语和谓语动词在人称和数上保持一致。例如，单数主语用单数动词，复数主语用复数动词。比较级用于比较两个事物，通常形容词后加-er，多音节词前加more。注意避免双重比较级（如more better）和比较对象不一致。本次重点复习这些影响理解准确性的错误。

His records showed that insurance premiums had actually fallen slightly between 1782 and 1788
